title: DSB: Dynamic Sliding Block Scheduling for Diffusion LLMs

layout.note: A prompt bar spans the top; below it five aligned token rows (Denoise T, Answer T, Denoise T+N, Answer T+N, Groud Truth) share four column groups; vertical dots mark elided steps, two red call-outs sit in the gaps and a dashed confidence key fills the right margin.

lesson: Show a failure of a scheduling rule on one toy sentence: redraw the same token strip at an early and a late step, colour cells by confidence and decoded state, add the ground-truth row, and pin two red call-outs on exactly the two symptoms.
